# DigiHust

> Digital Services Handled by Specialized Talent. One Company. One Point of Contact.

DigiHust is a modern digital agency and talent-powered solution company headquartered in Pakistan. Instead of requiring clients to hire and coordinate isolated freelancers, DigiHust provides single-contract, fully managed delivery across specialized multi-disciplinary teams sourced and verified through Digiskill.

## Core Capabilities
- **Web & Full-Stack Development**: Custom web applications, React, Next.js, Node.js, API architecture, database optimization, and cloud deployments.
- **Creative & UI/UX Design**: Brand identity systems, design systems, Figma UI/UX prototyping, vector graphics, motion design, and video editing.
- **AI & Workflow Automation**: Custom OpenAI / LLM integrations, chatbot assistants, workflow automations (n8n, Zapier, Make), and intelligent data extractors.
- **Digital Marketing & Growth**: SEO audit & execution, PPC advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads), content marketing, and B2B cold outreach strategies.
- **Cybersecurity & Cloud**: Web application penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, OWASP compliance, and security policy architecture.
- **Business Intelligence & Data**: PowerBI dashboard development, ETL pipelines, SQL reporting, and administrative digital assistance.

## Operating Model
1. **Intake & Scope**: Client provides project brief via `/contact` or proposal intake.
2. **Team Assembly**: DigiHust management matches verified domain specialists to the exact project requirements.
3. **Execution**: Transparent iterative sprint execution with structured milestone reviews and QA.
4. **Delivery**: Production deployment, comprehensive documentation handover, and post-launch support.
